[S124] Brian Bergen [V068] [1326]: Hi, guys. [S125] Good morning. [S126] Thank you. [S127] Bob, can you put some finer points just first on the level of organic growth in the third quarter and then bridge that forward to your commentary on the fourth quarter? [S128] If you can kind of unpack that [V069] 12% growth across the business, I think that would help.
[S129] Bob Schrader [V070] [1343]: Yeah, Brian, I think consistently, even if you go back to [V071] Q4 of last year, the organic growth of the business has been a bit weaker. [S130] I think a lot of that had to do with comparability issues, particularly in the PEO business with our MPP plan in Florida. [S131] But if you go back to [V072] Q4 of last year, I think we've seen sequential improvement each quarter in the organic growth of the business. [S132] So if you look at the first half, total revenue organic growth was roughly [V073] 4%, and that improved from [V074] Q1 to [V075] Q2. [S133] And then when you look at the back half, whether it's [V076] Q3 or [V077] Q4 combined, we would expect it accelerated in [V078] Q3, and we would expect to see similar organic growth. [S134] growth performance in [V079] Q4. [S135] And so you're now getting to a back half organic growth rate that's closer to [V080] 6%. [S136] And then when you put the two of those together, it's roughly [V081] 5% on a full year basis. [S137] And so, again, I think there's a couple drivers of it. [S138] You know, one, to be fair, is the easier compare on the PEO business. [S139] I mean, I think you'll see that. [S140] The headline PEO number sequentially went from [V082] 6% last quarter to [V083] 9%. [S141] There are some timing things there, but, you know, there's certainly strength in the underlying operating performance of the business, particularly in the PEO, and we can get into that probably in maybe some later questions. [S142] But we did anniversary the headwind last from the MPP enrollment. [S143] So that's why you're definitely seeing the combination of an easier compare, stronger operating performance, driving accelerated organic growth in the back half of the year.
